description: Closelooknet’s two US wires. wire=analyst: the latest sell-side calls (upgrades, downgrades, initiations, price-target moves), newest first, each with the house read where the name is covered (index/portfolio membership, 50/200-day state, Street consensus). wire=earnings: the latest prints against consensus EPS (beat / miss / in line with the surprise) plus the forward calendar. Mirrors closelook.net/signals/analysts/ and /signals/earnings/ (per-day archives under /archive/). Refreshed several times per trading day.
